summary: Vendor Compliance & Verification tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 24/24 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_vendor_compliance.py): ops-created vendors default to 'draft'; vendor verification GET/PUT/SUBMIT with empty-body 400 listing missing fields, save-draft persistence w/ IFSC uppercased & cert base64 stored, agreement doc returned to vendor; /ops/vendor-agreement GET readable by admin+operations, PUT bumps version for admin (restored after test), 403 for operations non-admin (correct via _admin_only inside handler after require_permission manage_vendors — same pattern used for approve/reject/suspend/status=active); compliance list+detail+status filter returns correct items with cert data; approve/reject/suspend end-to-end and reject-reason-required 400 verified on throwaway vendors; customer visibility gating confirmed (/api/restaurants excludes draftvendor@test.in, /api/restaurants/{draft_id}=>404, /api/drops 200 with no draft leakage); order-create against a non-active vendor menu item => 400 'not currently accepting orders' (before razorpay); PUT /api/vendor/drops/{id} with is_active=True as draft vendor => 403 'account must be approved before you can go live'. Frontend (mobile 390x844, draftvendor@test.in): Dashboard shows testID=verification-banner ('Complete your business verification. You must be approved before you can go live and receive orders.') → tap opens /vendor-verification with all sections rendered (Business Details, GST, FSSAI (Mandatory), Bank Details (Mandatory), Vendor Agreement, Legal Declaration). Agreement scroll box is scrollable; 'I have read and agree' CheckRow renders opacity:0.5 with helper text 'Scroll to the end of the agreement to continue.' i.e. disabled-until-scrolled (state-toggled by RN ScrollView onScroll — could not exercise via synthetic scroll events but initial disabled state + helper are verified). Submit for Approval, Save Draft, Full Legal Name, Designation, and 4 declaration checkboxes all render. Frontend (desktop 1440x900, admin anubhavg@perfectlygood.in): sidebar exposes Compliance and Vendor Agreement links. /ops/compliance shows filter chips Pending Verification | Active | Rejected | Suspended | Draft | All; Draft chip lists 'Draft Test Kitchen · draftvendor@test.in' with FSSAI/GST/Business columns; Review opens a detail Sheet displaying Business Details, GST, FSSAI (with Certificate viewer) and Approve & Activate / Reject / Suspend buttons. /ops/vendor-agreement renders 'Vendor Agreement' with Version 1.0 timestamp, Save & Publish button, Agreement Content editor and Optional PDF Download Link. No deprecated packages or React Native red screens observed on the tested screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2582-2584: /api/ops/vendor-agreement PUT uses require_permission('manage_vendors') then inline admin-only check. Operations has manage_vendors, so this relies on the extra check — correct, but a helper like _admin_only used consistently (as in approve/reject/suspend) would make the pattern easier to reason about.

server.py L579-588 correctly filters /api/drops by active vendor_ids; L682 filters /api/restaurants by status='active' and L723 /api/restaurants/{id} returns 404 for non-active — customer visibility gating is centralised and consistent.

server.py L2456-2463 _get_vendor_for_user allows role in ('vendor','admin') — this is intentional (admin can act on behalf), but note that admin-token calls to /api/vendor/verification will operate on whichever vendor row is user_id=admin (usually none => 404). No leak, just noting.

Frontend vendor-verification.tsx: agreement onScroll uses RN ScrollView contentOffset+layoutMeasurement+contentSize; on RN Web this works with real user scroll but is not triggerable via programmatic scrollTop or dispatched 'scroll' events — makes automated e2e coverage for the enable-checkbox transition awkward. Consider adding a fallback dev/test hook (e.g. testID on the scrollview + expose a __setScrolled window fn under DEV) if you want to automate this in future iterations. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks verified (except agreement-scroll-to-enable transition which needs real user scroll — see review comments)

Agreement doc bumped and restored to original version+content in TestVendorAgreementRBAC.test_admin_updates_and_bumps_version.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_vendor_compliance.py. Run with `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs -d '\n') && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_vendor_compliance.py -v` (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is required in env — not in shell by default). Draft vendor draftvendor@test.in / vendor123 was left in DRAFT status with pre-filled verification (business_name/rep/email/FSSAI+cert/bank) so subsequent runs can reuse it for UI testing. Ops non-admin (operations) RBAC for approve/reject/suspend/status=active/edit-agreement is enforced by _admin_only() called AFTER require_permission('manage_vendors') — operations DOES have manage_vendors so relying on _admin_only is correct. Frontend agreement scroll-to-enable requires a real mouse/touch scroll (synthetic scroll events don't fire RN ScrollView's onScroll on Web).
